meta.title: 一学就会的餐厅顶光爆改氛围光拍照
meta.title_en: Fix Restaurant Top Light for Atmosphere Photos

scenes.title_en: Trick 1: Let Your Hair Catch the Top Light
scenes.context: 工具人走到脸好看的一边，放大 1.9 倍，把向光侧头发放前面接光。
sentences: 先让工具人 走到你脸好看的一边。
First, have your helper stand on your better side.
把向着光的一侧头发 放到前面来。
Pull the hair on the light side forward.
让光打在我们的头发上。
Let the light hit your hair.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达让头发接光
Tuck the lit-side hair forward so the top light becomes a rim light.
换种说法表达拍摄角度
Angle the shot toward your better side and zoom in.
scenes.speak: First, have your helper stand on your better side. Zoom in to 1.9x. Pull the hair on the light side forward and let the light hit your hair.

scenes.title_en: Trick 2: Use a Plate as a Bounce
scenes.context: 脸很黑时拿盘子当反光板补光，对比非常明显。
sentences: 这时候 脸很黑怎么办呢。
What if your face turns out dark?
我们拿一个盘子 当做反光板。
Grab a plate and use it as a bounce.
这对比 真的很明显。
paraphrase: 换种说法表达盘子反光
A white plate bounces light right back onto your face.
换种说法表达效果明显
You can see the change instantly.
scenes.speak: What if your face turns out dark? Grab a plate and use it as a bounce. The difference is really obvious.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧三：紫色屏幕氛围光
scenes.context: 打开紫色图片，把屏幕调亮，照片更有氛围感。
paraphrase: 换种说法表达屏幕打光
A bright purple screen becomes a free color light.
换种说法表达氛围提升
The shot instantly feels more cinematic.
scenes.speak: Open a purple image and turn the screen brightness up. It adds atmosphere to the shot.

practice: Have your helper stand on your better side.
Grab a plate and use it as a bounce.
shifts: 主动让顶光为头发打轮廓
以为反光板必须专业道具
餐厅里盘子就是反光板
用屏幕氛围光一次拍到位
